GOVERNMENT OF TAMIL NADU

E-Mail: msrb@tn.gov.in

NOTIFICATION NO: 22/MRB/2025 DATED: 23.01.2026
CORRIGENDUM
In partial modification of the Notification No.22/MRB/2025
Dated: 18.12.2025 for the post of Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality
Qualification.
(i) The para No.8 “CENTRE FOR EXAMINATION" is changed as detailed
below.
8. CENTRE FOR EXAMINATION:
Examination will be conducted in the following 2(Two) Districts
S.No District Names
1 Chennai
2 Tiruvallur
Note:
The Board reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of
Examination Centres depending on administrative exigencies.
MEMBER SECRETARY
